findings.message:

	- EmptyByteArrayCopy
	- DynamicArrayCleanup
	- TupleAssignmentMultiStackSlotComponents
	- MemoryArrayCreationOverflow
	- privateCanBeOverridden
	- IncorrectEventSignatureInLibraries_0.4.x
	- ExpExponentCleanup
	- NestedArrayFunctionCallDecoder
	- ZeroFunctionSelector
	- DelegateCallReturnValue
	- ECRecoverMalformedInput
	- SkipEmptyStringLiteral
	- ConstantOptimizerSubtraction
	- IdentityPrecompileReturnIgnored
	- HighOrderByteCleanStorage
	- OptimizerStaleKnowledgeAboutSHA3
	- LibrariesNotCallableFromPayableFunctions.
It is used by:
	- ^0.4.0 (../sb/king_of_the_ether_throne.sol#24)

findings.message:
Reentrancy in KingOfTheEtherThrone.claimThrone(string) (../sb/king_of_the_ether_throne.sol#103-169):
	External calls:
	- msg.sender.send(excessPaid) (../sb/king_of_the_ether_throne.sol#118)
	- currentMonarch.etherAddress.send(compensation) (../sb/king_of_the_ether_throne.sol#132)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- currentClaimPrice = rawNewClaimPrice (../sb/king_of_the_ether_throne.sol#150)
	- currentClaimPrice = 100000000000000 * (rawNewClaimPrice / 100000000000000) (../sb/king_of_the_ether_throne.sol#152)
	- currentClaimPrice = 1000000000000000 * (rawNewClaimPrice / 1000000000000000) (../sb/king_of_the_ether_throne.sol#154)
	- currentClaimPrice = 10000000000000000 * (rawNewClaimPrice / 10000000000000000) (../sb/king_of_the_ether_throne.sol#156)
	- currentClaimPrice = 100000000000000000 * (rawNewClaimPrice / 100000000000000000) (../sb/king_of_the_ether_throne.sol#158)
	- currentClaimPrice = 1000000000000000000 * (rawNewClaimPrice / 1000000000000000000) (../sb/king_of_the_ether_throne.sol#160)
	- currentClaimPrice = 10000000000000000000 * (rawNewClaimPrice / 10000000000000000000) (../sb/king_of_the_ether_throne.sol#162)
	- currentClaimPrice = rawNewClaimPrice (../sb/king_of_the_ether_throne.sol#164)
	- currentMonarch = Monarch(msg.sender,name,valuePaid,block.timestamp) (../sb/king_of_the_ether_throne.sol#139-144)
	- pastMonarchs.push(currentMonarch) (../sb/king_of_the_ether_throne.sol#138)
	Event emitted after the call(s):
	- ThroneClaimed(currentMonarch.etherAddress,currentMonarch.name,currentClaimPrice) (../sb/king_of_the_ether_throne.sol#168)
findings.name: reentrancy-unlimited-gas
